reviews.text: Excellent service
Good service
Incredible attention and care for the dogs! 🤍 …
Excellent service, very kind to pets.

Excellent service! I've taken my furry friend there a couple of times now, and he always looks his best and gets lots of pampering. The atmosphere and the staff are incredibly professional and attentive. A shout-out to the great Ivan! 👌 Definitely recommended if you want your dog to look spectacular and receive top-notch care from start to finish.

Honestly, the service was terrible. They gave my dog ​​a really bad haircut, and the soap they used gave him an allergic reaction.
And nowhere else had I been charged extra based on my dog's age, which I found absurd. 🙄 …
A great place to buy pet food and take them for checkups. I like that they have good prices.

Completely incompetent and distracted, they didn't even complete the service I requested for my pet. The reception staff were constantly on their phones and couldn't fill out the service order without checking their phones every two seconds. I don't even want to imagine how they treat pets behind a desk. They have absolutely no passion for pet care.

I won't be returning.

The worst experience I've ever had at a vet clinic. Even though I had a scheduled appointment, they didn't have the medication ready. The examination room was being cleaned and was covered in water everywhere, including the examination table.

One of my cats hid under a piece of furniture and ended up soaked in dirty water. The staff doesn't communicate well; they're not clear.

This place is truly terrible.

Our dogs are getting on in years, and we always come here because they're treated with so much love. The groomers take excellent care of them and always recommend the best treatment and haircut for them.

We've also been to see Jaru, who specializes in senior dogs, and she's truly wonderful. She's so loving and empathetic, she listens and explains everything with so much patience. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing they're in good hands at this stage of their lives.

We'll definitely continue to trust her. Thank you for all your care and dedication!

🐶💛
Excellent service. 🛁 I took my dog ​​there for her first bath and she looked great. They were incredibly kind and professional. …

The service is excellent; the young woman who cares for the dogs is very professional and treats them well. Sometimes, as customers, we don't appreciate the work of the people who serve us; we should listen to their opinions since they are the experts in dog care.
I love it, it has everything and my dog ​​always comes out super happy

Pet N’Go Condesa provides excellent service. They have a great variety of products, and the staff is very friendly and patient. You can tell they love animals, and they help you find exactly what you need. Highly recommended.
I went to buy toys for my dog ​​and the service was excellent. I loved it!
Very good groomer. I have two Poodles and we go there all the time. They work well with a picture, but if not they always do their best. It takes a long time but I am always happy with their work.
Good treatment and service
They pampered Elvis and made him look handsome!
My little one came out of his bath very happy, they sent me videos of him when they were shaving him and he was very calm.
It's the only place I completely trust to leave my babies. 🫰🏻 …
I really like it; I always take my Pomeranian there for a haircut and bath, and I love how they do her. I like that it has a glass window so I can see them bathing the animals if I want…
Excellent place to find supplies for your best friend; they have a grooming salon and also sell food. Excellent service for dog and cat parents.

Awful!!! This is the second time I've made an appointment and they've kept my dog ​​in a cage for over an hour waiting for her service. They returned her to me wet after I'd left her for an hour and a half!
They've never taken more than an hour to bathe her before! Because they're always trying to sell more appointments, they overbook them, so there are thousands of dogs in cages waiting their turn. 😡😡😡😡😡
They don't respect their opening hours; they say they open at 9 but they're never open on time, and today they made me wait an hour because they didn't open until after 10.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for almost a year and the service has been good, but today I took her for a haircut and they told me that a young woman was learning to cut hair and made a mistake. Instead of cutting 1 cm off, she used the wrong razor and shaved my dog! They shouldn't let someone cut hair if they don't know how and learn on the dogs there! I was very upset with the service today!

I took my dog ​​to be bathed today. I've been taking him there for many years, and today there was a girl there who I don't know if she's new, but I'd never seen her before. I asked for a scissor cut because my dog ​​had some knots, which I told her she could cut. In the end, she gave him back a buzz cut, which I hadn't authorized. I felt terrible because she didn't even tell me they were going to use clippers. On top of that, she told me it was with scissors, which obviously wasn't true. My dog ​​has been sad; he's already a big boy. It makes me so sad to see him like this, when he's like a son to me.

The grooming and veterinary services are amazing, the staff are super friendly and attentive. I've taken my dog ​​there since he came to live with me, and he loves them.
Dr. Jaru is fantastic. 🐶💕 …
Great care for the furry ones! I always take my puppy here for a bath and he happily plays with the staff! They even watch him for a few minutes while I pick him up. Highly recommended!
The best place to get your dogs' hair cut, I highly recommend it
Very nice people and I like how they cut my two dogs' hair!
Antonio provided amazing service, was super friendly, and did a fantastic job with the haircut. My dog ​​looked gorgeous! Thank you so much!
Fair and good service
Excellent grooming service. Thank you, Antonio 👍🏻 …
The attitude of the young lady who served us on Tuesday afternoon was terrible; it makes you not want to go back ☹️

The first time I took my dog, the haircut was done well, but on subsequent visits, he was injured. The worst part is that they didn't inform me at the time; they only told us something after we discovered it ourselves. The lack of communication and transparency in the service left a bad impression.

My dog ​​always ends up super happy after his bath here (even though he hates baths)! They're very attentive to the dogs and you can tell they really care about them because every time I walk by they greet my dog ​​and give him treats 🥰 …
They're the best!! They give my dogs amazing baths
We've been taking my dog ​​to their bath and grooming service for eight months now, and they always do a great job. Highly recommended. Saul always gives her really beautiful hairstyles.
Variety of products
The service is the best! I have 3 dogs and they always leave them looking perfect, plus they always have a great attitude and you can tell they treat them very well.
Excellent service, the staff is super friendly. I've been taking my pets there for years and they pamper them immensely.
They provide the perfect service. The haircut and bath are very quick. My dog ​​is always happy afterward. Thank you!
I've been taking my two dogs to Pet N'Go for several months now. They've always been super professional and the cuts on my two Shih Tzus are perfect!
Very kind and friendly with the dogs, we came to the vet and they took great care of my dog

The service I received at Pet N'Go Condesa was excellent. My dog ​​Rocco received the best care from Naye, the veterinarian, who was incredibly kind and very clear in explaining the steps to follow. Thanks to her approach, we were able to figure out what was wrong with him, and now he's receiving the right treatment.

Many thanks to Naye and the Pet N'Go team!

This is a fantastic spot for all your pet needs, and they offer grooming services too! The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, making it easy to find exactly what you’re looking for. The store is well-organized, and the overall experience is always pleasant. Highly recommend for pet owners!
Great place, very good treatment of pets and very professional
Excellent service, everyone is very kind and attentive to the dogs.
Excellent, always helpful and my dog ​​is happy and well bathed
A BEAUTIFUL, WELL-EQUIPPED, MODERN, AND CLEAN STORE WITH REASONABLE PRICES!!! EXCELLENT SERVICE, THE BEST!!! AND A PHENOMENAL LOCATION.
Excellent service, my dog ​​always goes happily for baths and haircuts.
Excellent service and very considerate of the dogs, highly recommended
Excellent service. Unique at the counter and Eduardo bathing the dogs do a fantastic job. Thank you!
Very happy with the haircut they gave Eros, a 10 out of 10, Eduardo Herrera is a genius ☺️
Excellent service from the place and from Eduardo.
I love the way they treat the dogs. My dog ​​loves to stop by and says hello, and he looks so handsome after his bath. 🐶 Excellent service. …
Excellent service, they treat my dog ​​very well and are very kind.

I really like that the dogs are out in the open. Judging by how my dog ​​behaves, I don't think he's ever been mistreated. The prices are good, and when they cut his hair, it's just important to give clear instructions. Excellent service!
I always bring my dog ​​to PetNGo 💕 they're the best!!! …

I'm so happy with the service at this dog spa and salon! I take my pups there and they always come out looking perfect. Saúl is a true professional, with tons of experience and dedication; you can tell he loves what he does. My dogs are always happy and relaxed after their visit. Highly recommended!

Thank you so much for your kind attention. My mom brought our dog in for a bath and haircut, and she looks amazing!
We are so grateful for everything. Mr. Eduardo Herrera did a great job grooming our pet.
My mother and I will be back soon.
I really liked Eduardo Herrera's service; he made my Nicky look very handsome, following the details I requested for his haircut, leaving his mohawk perfect.
Excellent service and treatment at the store, especially from Eduardo Herrera. They were very kind to the dogs.
Excellent veterinary care! Thanks to Nadyeli, my kitten was saved from parvovirus! She truly has a great vocation and love for animals. I highly recommend her!
They wanted to charge me $6,700 for a PCR test for feline leukemia virus when everywhere else it costs $1,500 maximum

Terrible service! The receptionist was on a call across the street, there was no one to help. Then the "manager" arrived and was incredibly arrogant, acting like he owned the place. He treated me in a rude and overbearing manner. These are the same stores that used to be called ANIMALIA, they just changed the name. AWFUL SERVICE!!!
The worst in terms of installation and service; only Uinique makes it worthwhile.

For years I've taken my dog ​​Paris there, now it's my Ramona's turn 🐶 and the result is the best as always! They groom the dogs exactly how you want them and the price is good for the area! Follow Ramona on Instagram as @maltipoo_ramona 🫶🏻🫰🏼 …
I was looking for raincoats for my dogs and found an option there. They let me try them on and gave them treats to calm them down. Excellent service.
I took Duke to get a bath and they made him look gorgeous! The service is excellent, they are very attentive.
